breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 120 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.1.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that using dt=0.001 for 120 steps would result in a final time of T=0.12, which contradicts the specified domain T in [0, 0.1]. The agent resolved this by specifying to use exactly 100 time steps, which is consistent with T/dt (0.1 / 0.001 = 100). This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
